mapper.select: SELECT collection_id, name, description, creator_id, created_at, updated_at FROM collections WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} ORDER BY created_at

SELECT c.collection_id AS collectionId, COUNT(cn.note_id) AS cnt FROM collections c LEFT JOIN collection_notes cn ON c.collection_id = cn.collection_id WHERE c.creator_id = #{creatorId} GROUP BY c.collection_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collections (name, description, creator_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{creatorId})
